title: 石州慢·寒水依痕
title_en: Shi Zhou Man: The Cold Water Keeps to Its Old Line
author: 张元干

form.en: ci to the tune Shi Zhou Man, in two stanzas

text_note.zh: 资料库原文“冷蕊”作“冷芯”，应是传抄或转换中的错字，这里依通行本作“蕊”。另外，“暗销”有的本子作“暗消”，“却相逢”有的本子作“再相逢”，意思差不多。
text_note.en: The source text has a wrong character for ruǐ (flower buds); this follows the common text. Some editions also have a different character for xiāo (to wear away), or zài (again) for què in the line about meeting again; the meaning is about the same.

readings.zh: “数枝”是几枝的意思，“数”读 shù。读 shǔ 时是“数一数”。
readings.en: In shù zhī (several sprigs) the character is read shù. Read shǔ, it means to count.

readings.zh: “重叠”的“重”读 chóng，是一层又一层的意思。
readings.en: In chóng dié (layer upon layer) the character is read chóng.

glosses.zh: 依痕：贴着原来的水痕。冬天水落下去，留下旧水痕，早春的水还没有涨起来。
glosses.en: yī hén: keeping to the old water line. In winter the water drops and leaves a mark; in early spring it has not yet risen.

glosses.zh: 沙际：沙滩边上。
glosses.en: shā jì: the edge of the sandbank.

glosses.zh: 烟阔：水上雾气一片，看上去很开阔。
glosses.en: yān kuò: mist spreading wide over the water.

glosses.zh: 晴照：晴天的阳光照着。
glosses.en: qíng zhào: shining in the clear sunlight.

glosses.zh: 冷蕊：寒天里的花朵，指梅花。蕊，花心，代指花。
glosses.en: lěng ruǐ: flowers in the cold, meaning plum blossoms. Ruǐ is the heart of a flower.

glosses.zh: 争发：抢着开放。
glosses.en: zhēng fā: rushing to bloom.

glosses.zh: 天涯：天边，指离家很远的地方。
glosses.en: tiān yá: the edge of the sky, a place far from home.

glosses.zh: 旧恨：旧日的愁苦，这里指离别的痛苦。
glosses.en: jiù hèn: old sorrow, here the pain of parting.

glosses.zh: 几许：多少。
glosses.en: jǐ xǔ: how much.

glosses.zh: 消魂：伤心得好像魂都没了，形容极度悲伤。南朝江淹《别赋》说“黯然销魂者，唯别而已矣”。
glosses.en: xiāo hún: so sad it is as if your soul melts away. The writer Jiang Yan said nothing makes the soul melt like parting.

glosses.zh: 长亭：古时路边供人歇脚的亭子，也是送别的地方。
glosses.en: cháng tíng: a roadside pavilion where travellers rested and friends said goodbye.

glosses.zh: 眼中青：眼前望不到头的青山和草色。
glosses.en: yǎn zhōng qīng: the endless green of hills and grass before his eyes.

glosses.zh: 情切：感情急切、深挚。
glosses.en: qíng qiè: feelings that are deep and urgent.

glosses.zh: 画楼：装饰华美的楼，指她住的地方。
glosses.en: huà lóu: a beautifully painted building, where she lives.

glosses.zh: 暗销肌雪：雪白的肌肤悄悄消瘦了。意思是她因为思念而消瘦。
glosses.en: àn xiāo jī xuě: her snow-white skin quietly wastes away. That is, she grows thin from missing him.

glosses.zh: 辜负：白白错过了，对不起。
glosses.en: gū fù: to let something go to waste, to fail someone.

glosses.zh: 云雨：这里指夫妻或恋人之间的亲密欢爱。
glosses.en: yún yǔ: here, the closeness of husband and wife or lovers.

glosses.zh: 尊前花月：对着酒杯、赏花看月的美好时光。尊，酒杯。
glosses.en: zūn qián huā yuè: happy times with wine, flowers and the moon. Zūn is a wine cup.

glosses.zh: 心期：心中盼望的事，心里的约定。
glosses.en: xīn qī: what the heart hopes for, a promise kept in the heart.

glosses.zh: 殷勤：情意恳切、周到。
glosses.en: yīn qín: warm and earnest.

glosses.zh: 留与：留给，留下来等到。
glosses.en: liú yǔ: to save for.

glosses.zh: 经年：过了一整年，指分别很久。
glosses.en: jīng nián: a whole year gone, a long parting.

translation.zh: 寒冷的江水还贴着旧日的水痕，
translation.en: The cold water still keeps to its old line,

translation.zh: 春意渐渐回来了，
translation.en: and the feeling of spring is slowly coming back.

translation.zh: 沙滩边，雾气一片开阔。
translation.en: By the sandbank, mist spreads wide.

translation.zh: 溪边的梅花在晴光里散发清香，
translation.en: Plum blossoms by the stream give off scent in the sunshine,

translation.zh: 寒天里几枝花抢着开放。
translation.en: a few sprigs in the cold rushing to bloom.

translation.zh: 远在天边，旧日离别的愁苦，
translation.en: Far from home, the old sorrow of parting:

translation.zh: 你看它让人多么伤心，
translation.en: see how it makes my soul melt away.

translation.zh: 长亭外面，山峦一层又一层。
translation.en: Beyond the farewell pavilion, hills rise layer on layer.

translation.zh: 望不尽的满眼青色，
translation.en: The green that fills my eyes never ends;

translation.zh: 正是愁绪涌来的时候。
translation.en: this is the season when sorrow comes.

translation.zh: 我的情意多么深切。
translation.en: How deep and urgent my feelings are.

translation.zh: 想她在画楼里紧闭着门，
translation.en: I picture her shut deep inside the painted house.

translation.zh: 我想象东风吹过，
translation.en: I imagine the east wind blowing,

translation.zh: 她雪白的肌肤悄悄消瘦了。
translation.en: and her snow-white skin quietly growing thin.

translation.zh: 白白辜负了枕边的恩爱，
translation.en: We have let our closeness go to waste,

translation.zh: 还有对着酒杯赏花看月的时光。
translation.en: and the times of wine, flowers and moonlight.

translation.zh: 在心里最想念的时候，
translation.en: When my longing is at its sharpest,

translation.zh: 还有多少凄凉的心事，
translation.en: how much loneliness I still carry,

translation.zh: 我要好好留着，等回家时说给她听。
translation.en: which I will save, with all my heart, to tell her when I come home.

translation.zh: 等到我们真的重逢时，
translation.en: By the time we finally meet again,

translation.zh: 恰好已经分别整整一年了。
translation.en: it will have been a whole year apart.

background.zh: 这首词写作的具体时间不清楚。作者在外地漂泊，早春时节看见寒水、梅花和重重青山，想起远在家中的心上人，写下了这首词。上阕写他乡早春的景色和离愁，下阕设想对方在家里思念自己，日渐消瘦，最后说要把满心的凄凉留到回家时慢慢说。一说词中的离愁还带着对国事的忧虑。
background.en: We do not know exactly when this ci was written. The poet was far from home. In early spring he saw the cold water, the plum blossoms and the layers of green hills, and thought of the one he loved at home. The first stanza shows early spring in a strange place and the pain of parting. The second imagines her at home missing him and growing thin. At the end he says he will save all his loneliness to tell her when he gets back. Some readers think the sorrow also hides worry about the troubled country.

author_note.zh: 张元干（1091—？），字仲宗，号芦川居士，两宋之交的词人。他早年的词写得清丽婉转。北宋灭亡后，他坚决主张抗金，曾写词送别被贬的抗金大臣胡铨，因此被朝廷除名。他后期的词多慷慨激昂，是南宋爱国词人的先驱之一。
author_note.en: Zhang Yuangan (born 1091; the year of his death is uncertain) lived as the Northern Song gave way to the Southern Song. His early ci are graceful and gentle. After the north fell he strongly urged resistance against the Jin. He wrote a farewell ci for Hu Quan, an official punished for opposing peace with the Jin, and lost his own official rank for it. His later ci are bold and stirring, and he is seen as an early patriotic ci poet.

appreciation.zh: 开头写早春很细：水还贴着旧水痕，说明冰雪刚化；沙滩上烟雾一片；几枝梅花在冷风里抢着开。景色是新的，心情却是旧的，看到长亭外一层层的山，满眼青色望不到头，愁就跟着涌上来。下阕最动人的是“想见”：他不写自己多想她，而是想象她在画楼里也想着他，人都瘦了。最后他把满肚子的话“殷勤留与归时说”，好像存起来的信，要等见面时一句句讲。可结尾一算，见面时已经分别一整年了。期待里带着心酸，读来很真切。
appreciation.en: The opening paints early spring with care. The water still keeps to its old line, so the ice has only just melted. Mist lies over the sandbank. A few plum sprigs rush to bloom in the cold wind. The scene is new, but the feeling is old. Seeing hill after hill beyond the farewell pavilion, green without end, his sorrow rises. The most touching word in the second stanza is 'I picture'. He does not say how much he misses her. He imagines her in the painted house missing him, growing thin. At the end he saves everything he wants to say until he gets home, like letters kept in a drawer, to be read out line by line when they meet. Then he counts: by then they will have been apart a whole year. Hope and heartache mix, and it feels very real.
